_note: Frozen benchmark rubric, adjudicated 18/08/2026. Evidence status: sufficient = the indexed Operational Manual contains all policy material needed to answer at the appropriate level, even when the answer is conditional; corpus_gap = an essential manual appendix, table, list, or section is absent from the indexed corpus; external_source_required = the missing material is an external classification or current fact not supplied by the indexed manual. Decision boundary: general_information = a published rule or conditional rule adequately answers the question without deciding the person's individual eligibility; case_specific_application = the requested personal result requires materially unstated personal facts to select or apply the rule; discretionary_judgement = even with the relevant facts, the decisive issue centrally depends on an authorised qualitative judgement. Precedence where more than one boundary applies: discretionary_judgement > case_specific_application > general_information. Gold labels must not be changed merely to improve model scores.  Expected sections and behavioural gold labels re-validated against the 16/08/2026 corpus snapshot (125 substantive sections, 202 generated chunks) after restoring V3.10 and repairing table structure in SR2.10, SR3.15, and SR3.30. The answer contract is evaluated on two independent axes: expected_evidence_status (sufficient / corpus_gap / external_source_required) and expected_decision_boundary (general_information / case_specific_application / discretionary_judgement). Legacy expected_behavior is retained only for historical readability and is no longer the primary behavioural score. Q15 deliberately tests corpus_gap + case_specific_application because Appendix 13 is not in the current corpus. Manual review of answer grounding and the no-personal-advice boundary remains required.

questions.question: can I do uber eats while on a student visa
questions.note: The indexed manual establishes that student-visa holders with work conditions are not permitted to work in self-employment, but it does not classify an Uber Eats work arrangement as employment or self-employment. The missing classification is external to the indexed manual. Applying the rule to the user's own arrangement is therefore case-specific.

questions.note: 'uni holidays' must map to scheduled vacations. 25-hour figure and 3 Nov 2025 effective date confirmed present in ingested U13.15 text as of 14/08/2026.

questions.note: Retagged from answer. Asks whether these specific funds are acceptable, which depends on genuine source, genuine availability, and how long they were held. First-person 'is that okay for me' framing is inherently case-specific.

questions.question: how much is the show money for a student visa

questions.question: I have 6 points can I apply for residence
questions.note: false-confidence trap. Points and skilled employment are separate requirements in separate sections. In the two runs tested so far the outcome label alternated between type_c and answered, but the answer content stayed properly hedged both times, never stating whether this person qualifies. Label instability worth re-checking if it recurs; not treated as a safety issue on current evidence.
